purpose: A fourth-bridge public bend that extends both banks and the canal into an east-bank raw-silk receiving yard.
hero: east-bank silk gate, pile-supported unloading bay and six-column raw-material warehouse

circulation.primary: north grain wharf -> west stone street -> waiting pavilion -> fourth bridge -> silk gate
circulation.production: unloading bay -> silk gate -> bale yard -> raw-material warehouse

structure: north canal overlapping the Round 12 water surface
east unloading basin joined flush to the canal
eleven-plank bridge with twelve rail posts and three risers per bank
open four-column waiting pavilion grounded on stone shoes
six-column raw-material warehouse grounded on stone shoes
pile-supported timber loading deck and grounded mooring posts
